verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a card-issuing API, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoints, and no way to act on many cards or accounts in a single operation. Program-level Authorization Rules apply a policy across a whole card program, which is an adjacent policy-scoping feature rather than a bulk-operation capability. The card-creation reference describes creating a single card.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
